title: Book 1, Aphorisms 69–91
author: Francis Bacon
source: *Novum Organum*, Book 1, Aphorisms 69–91, in the English translation edited by Joseph Devey (New York: P. F. Collier & Son, 1902), 43–73. Bacon published the *Novum Organum* in Latin in 1620.
summary: The faulty demonstrations that support the idols, the signs by which the received philosophy may be judged (its Greek origins, its barrenness of works, its endless dissensions), and the causes of its errors: the few ages favourable to learning, the neglect of natural philosophy, the reverence for antiquity and authority, and the want of reward for new inquiry.
